quote.text: No hay que censurar a los dioses porque no yerran en nada, ni contra su voluntad ni a propósito. Tampoco a los hombres, porque en nada yerran si no es contra su voluntad. En conclusión no hay que censurar a nadie.
quote.author: Marco  Aurelio
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that like the gods and men in the quote, children act according to their own will. Embrace their mistakes as natural and as chances for growth.
    • Foster an environment where learning from errors is encouraged, permitting your children to develop autonomy while still feeling supported and understood.
  • Leadership
    • Leaders should understand that errors are seldom acts of malice but rather the result of human fallibility. This comprehension can cultivate a more forgiving and resilient organizational culture.
    • By acknowledging that mistakes are opportunities for reflection and improvement, you can inspire trust and motivate your team to pursue excellence without fearing undue criticism.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, missteps are often unintended consequences rather than deliberate errors. Such moments are invaluable for learning and iterating on your product.
    • Adopt a mindset that values reflection over blame; each error is a chance to adjust your strategy, enhancing user experience and leading your team towards innovative solutions.
